The migration is complete. `pages/` is gone, everything is TypeScript, and the build plus a live production server confirm every route behaves correctly.

## What moved where

| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` |
| `pages/index.js` | `app/page.tsx` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` | `app/blog/page.tsx` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` (`'use client'`) |

## Replaced APIs

- **`next/head` → Metadata API.** Static `metadata` exports, plus `generateMetadata` on `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` for the per-post title/OG tags.
- **`next/document`** has no App Router equivalent; `<Html>/<Head>/<Main>/<NextScript>` became real `<html>/<head>/<body>` in the root layout.
- **`getServerSideProps` → async server component.** `req.headers['user-agent']` became `await headers()` (async in Next 15+), and the posts fetch uses `cache: 'no-store'` to keep per-request freshness.
- **`getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `export const revalidate`** (60s on `/blog`, 300s on `/blog/[id]`).
- **`getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`**; `fallback: 'blocking'` → `export const dynamicParams = true`.
- **`{ notFound: true }` → `notFound()`** from `next/navigation`.
- **`useRouter` from `next/router` → `next/navigation`**, isolated into two small client components (`PushButton`, `BackButton`) so the pages stay server components.
- **`req`/`res` handlers → method exports** with `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`. `req.body` became `await request.json()`, and `req.query.id` became `await params` (params are Promises now).

## Two judgment calls worth flagging

- **`router.isFallback` was dead code.** With `fallback: 'blocking'`, Next never renders a fallback, so that branch never ran. I initially added `app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx` for it, but that streams a 200 before `notFound()` executes — `/blog/9999` returned 200 instead of 404. I removed it; missing posts now correctly return 404. If you'd rather have a loading skeleton, it comes at the cost of the 404 status.
- **The `Allow` header on 405s is gone.** Next's automatic 405 for non-exported methods doesn't set `Allow` (verified: `DELETE /api/posts` → 405, no header). The method-per-export design is the intended replacement for the manual `req.method` dispatch, so I didn't reintroduce it — say the word if you need that header back.

Also: `jsx: "react-jsx"` was preserved (the build tried to rewrite tsconfig to `preserve` formatting; I kept your original settings and only added the `.next/dev/types` include it needs), and I extended `.gitignore` to cover `.next/`, `next-env.d.ts`, and `*.tsbuildinfo`, which the build now generates.
